build_AVTh_model: build an AVT head model using GPT-2 for future feature prediction with configurable output length
create_MLP_predictor: create an MLP module with configurable layers to transform input features and predict future states
create_Identity_module: create an Identity nn.Module wrapper that passes features through unchanged with output_dim property
review_AVTh_forward: review the AVTh forward method that performs autoregressive rollout with GPT-2 past key caching
test_AVTh_quantize_rollout: test the AVTh model with quantize_before_rollout enabled to use top-1 cluster assignment during prediction
